jobs.title: Business Development Representative (BDR / SDR)
jobs.description: Team login ← All roles You’re a great fit if this lights you up Business Development Representative (BDR / SDR) Join a team building fundraising technology that helps nonprofits raise more and do more good. Remote / Hybrid (occasional meetings - IL) We're hiring for this role Apply for this role About the role About Us Most jobs ask you to choose between doing well and doing good. This one doesn't.CauseMatch is the fundraising platform nonprofits use to run their biggest campaigns. Every account you bring raises more for a real impact. Your commission and the world's good are doing the same math.We're growing the team. Long-term career in Israel We hire and grow in Israel. No forced relocation when a board decides to rebuild go-to-market in New York. Our Founder has built his family and home here, and our team in Israel will stay here too. Every account matters Each account that you bring will raise more funds for Jewish nonprofits and thus help more people, and make more impact. You're not just selling vanilla SaaS. You're selling something that truly improves the world. The Role As a Business Development Representative, you are the first human contact many nonprofits have with CauseMatch. Your job is to find the right organizations, start real conversations, and book qualified meetings for our Account Executives. You are not blasting generic emails and hoping something lands. You research each prospect, understand their fundraising reality, and reach out with something worth reading. This is a role for someone who wants to learn consultative selling from the ground up and grow into a closing seat. The best BDRs here treat their pipeline like their own business. What You Will Do Build and work a targeted list of nonprofit prospects that fit our ideal customer profile: Jewish organizations with annual budgets between $200K and $10M, led by Executive Directors, Development Directors, and Founders. Run outbound across email, phone, and LinkedIn, with sequences you personalize based on real research, not templates you never touch. Qualify prospects against our criteria (budget, fundraising history, fit for the ambassador-driven model) so the meetings you set are worth an AE's time. Book discovery calls and hand off clean, well-documented context to the Account Executive. Learn our story cold: why people give to people not causes, why our tech and services lifts results. Keep your pipeline accurate in HubSpot so your numbers tell the truth. Use AI tools to research faster, write sharper, and cover more ground without losing the personal touch. What Success Looks Like In your first month you know our product, our market, and our ICP well enough to hold a real conversation with a Development Director. By month three you are consistently hitting your targets for qualified meetings set and meetings that convert into opportunities. Over time, your best-fit prospecting and clean handoffs make you the BDR every AE loves getting leads from. We measure the role on qualified opportunities generated, meeting set rate, meeting-to-opportunity conversion, and outbound quality, not on raw activity for its own sake. What We Are Looking For One to three years in a sales, business development, or customer-facing role. Strong entry-level candidates with the right drive will be considered. Clear, persuasive writing. You can make a cold email feel like it was written for one person because it was. Comfort on the phone and a genuine willingness to start conversations with strangers. Curiosity and research instinct. You dig into a prospect before you reach out. Coachability. You want feedback and you act on it fast. Organization and follow-through. Nothing falls through the cracks in your pipeline. Comfort using AI tools in daily work. Nice to Have Experience selling to nonprofits, or a background in fundraising, development, or the nonprofit world. Familiarity with the Jewish nonprofit community. Experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM. Why Join You will learn consultative sales inside a company that lives and breathes it, with real coaching and a clear path toward an Account Executive seat. You will sell a product that helps mission-driven organizations raise money they would not have raised otherwise. And you will do it alongside a team that treats craft, ownership, and impact as the standard, not the exception. Ready to apply? Read the role, then send a short application. It goes straight to our hiring team. Remote / Hybrid (occasional meetings - IL) Apply now Form is below · takes a few minutes Apply now We'd love to meet you Share a bit about yourself. Your application goes straight to our hiring team. We read every application carefully and follow up when there is a fit. jobs.title: Senior Account Executive
jobs.description: Senior Account Executive · CauseMatch Team login ← All roles You’re a great fit if this lights you up Senior Account Executive Join a team building fundraising technology that helps nonprofits raise more and do more good. Hybrid / Remote (Israel) We're hiring for this role Apply for this role About the role CauseMatch Senior Account Executive The ideal candidate is a highly passionate and independent person with an understanding of consultative sales, lead generation, and the nonprofit market. The position is both challenging and rewarding and you’ll be working with a variety of nonprofit clients focused in the American market. This is a sales role with real meaning and the ability to make a big social impact. Generous compensation package with fixed salary and significant monthly variable pay based on reaching sales targets. Your feedback and client insights will be heard and highly valued. If you’re tired of “plain digital” and are ready to join a social impact start-up with a proven business model, we’d love to learn more about you. Your day-to-day Develop new business and progress existing prospect relationships Provide consultative sales, guidance and authentic value to your prospects and customers Manage all aspects of the sales pipeline in Hubspot, including lead prospecting, scheduling pitch meetings, preparing sales materials, and appropriate follow-up Compose and implement quarterly and annual business plans to achieve sales goals and targets. Closely follow current market intelligence, trends, client feedback, and business needs to align with CauseMatch strategic initiatives Manage and validate pipeline by assessing early-stage opportunities to ensure you have enough pipeline at all times to meet or exceed quota. Build intelligent, strategic fundraising proposals for potential CauseMatch clients Communicate internally with relevant stakeholders on the product, marketing, and operations teams Strategize with team members to innovate and improve the overall sales process Spend time outside of the office with clients and prospects to enhance working relationships Who you are Loves nonprofits and wants to change the world Minimum 2 years experience in consultative sales (B2B) or fundraising experience required Culturally fluent both with the Jewish market segment and non-Jewish market segment Happy and available to work American hours Deals with change easily and is flexible Strong writing skills, your words cause people to take action Energetic phone skills and excellent listening skills Experienced in networking and outbound lead generation Deeply thoughtful about the art and science of sales People-person, friendly and warm Driven and passionate Language: Native English Independently motivated and happy to work on own projects, a self-starter Flexible working hours Who we are CauseMatch is the next generation of digital fundraising for nonprofits. We support amazing organizations and their causes by providing fundraising solutions that engage their communities and increase their impact, typically raising 3-6x more than traditional online platforms. Our international team is passionate about making a positive change through the work we do and clients we help. Our culture and company perks! Flexible work hours and WFH options Generous company holiday schedule - paid vacation for all major Jewish holidays and Chol HaMoed Team and work is driven by our company values and core principles. Ready to apply? Read the role, then send a short application. It goes straight to our hiring team.
